query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, sp.objective, sp.current_level, sp.total_hours_learned, sp.streak_days
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN student_profiles sp ON u.id = sp.user_id
WHERE u.email = 'jenifer.borges@influx.com.br';
